notes: Profile: mid-sized CX platform provider running multi-tenant contact centers for retail + telco clients.
Primary pain: unpredictable LLM latency/cost during holiday seasonal peaks (BFCM). Need graceful degradation and clear fallback paths.

Workload characteristics: agent-assist real-time suggestions (short prompts), ticket summarization (batch after call), automated tool-calls (CRM -> ticket link, ownership), reranking for suggested articles.
Targets: median latency <= 120ms for single-response agent-suggestions; p95 <= 350ms under peak; sustain 2500 concurrent agent sessions during peak bursts (expected 3x daily, 4x seasonal).
Throughput: baseline 600 req/s, expected burst to 2400 req/s; plan to use session affinity + local KV cache to reduce token re-computation.
Model preferences: prefer Redwood-verified open models with quantized variants for Dedicated; fallback to smaller on-prem variant when capacity constrained.

Routing/fallback needs: per-customer routing policy (latency first for premium accounts), automatic model fallback (gpt-like -> condensed local model), region failover to us-west/eu-west with data residency controls.
Security: must pass SAML SSO test, provide audit logs for token-level access, KMS integration required for keys, retention policy configurable per-tenant.
POC ask: end-to-end spike test (ramp to 4x baseline), cost estimates for autoscaling + burst capacity, canary rollback plan for model rollout.
Quote (Head of Ops): "If we lose sub-300ms on suggestions during Cyber Week, throughput drops and agent handle times double — unacceptable. We need predictable fallbacks."
Quote (CTO): "Show us the unit economics: per-conversation token cost at scale with/without prefix caching."
Current stance: leaning Dedicated for guaranteed throughput + VPC, but will consider Hosted API with Optimize toolbox if cost / performance tradeoffs are favorable.
Related artifacts: sandbox logs (drive link), stress-test script (repo stub), security questionnaire answers pending SOC2 cert copy.
Decision drivers: latency SLO proof, predictable billing, SAML + KMS integration, legal sign-off on retention/residency.
